resources.string: Off. An optional copy on your own server
Optional. Ampulse works fully offline. If you run your own Ampulse server, the app can send it a copy of your data. Nothing is ever downloaded from the server, and nothing goes to anyone else.
Profile names, medicine names, doses and notes, the dose times from your schedules (30 days back, 14 days ahead), your marks — taken or skipped — and extra doses. Over HTTPS only.
Not sent: blood pressure, the medicine cabinet and packs, family contacts, the emergency card, injection sites, schedule rules.
